<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="592.0mm" height="43.7mm" viewBox="0 0 592.0 43.7" data-device="7280cr3a-24d12" data-view="right" data-weight="14.8 kg (32.6 lbs) for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12 (guide Table 1); 32.6 lbs (14.79 kg) in the data sheet" data-size-over-ears="48.3 x 4.4 x 59.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 23.3 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)" data-throughput="7.2 (14.4) Tbps" data-packets-per-second="2.7 Bpps" data-latency="from 3.8 us" data-packet-buffer="8 GB" data-max-400g-ports="12" data-max-100g-ports="72" data-max-50g-ports="116" data-max-40g-ports="36" data-max-25-10g-ports="116" data-max-total-interfaces="116" data-power-draw-typical-w="346" data-power-draw-max-w="845" data-power-draw-note="Data sheet: "346 W / 845 W", typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers. Guide Table 4 reads TBD." data-psu-redundancy="1+1" data-input-ac="200 - 240 VAC, 9.6 A (PWR-1511-AC), IEC 60320 C14" data-input-dc="-48 to -60 VDC (PWR-1511-DC)" data-airflow="front-to-back" data-fan-redundancy="3 hot-swap fan modules, N+1" data-operating-temp="0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F)" data-storage-temp="-25 to 70 C (-13 to 158 F)" data-storage-temp-datasheet="-40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet" data-altitude="0 to 3,000 m (0 to 10,000 ft)" data-humidity="5 to 90 percent, non-condensing" data-cpu="Eight-core x86" data-system-memory="64 GB" data-ssd-storage="480 GB" data-software="EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet" data-feature-license="EOS Feature Licenses Group 4" data-optics-qsfp28="each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-optics-qsfp-dd="each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-precision-timing="PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs" data-encryption="none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12" data-console="RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control" data-oob="10/100/1000 Ethernet management port" data-safety="EN 62368-1:2020+A11:2020, IEC 62368-1:2018, CSA/UL 62368-1:2019, AS/NZS 62368.1:2022" data-emissions="FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015" data-regulatory-model-number="AN1779 (DCS-7280CR3A-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AM-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12), guide Table 14" data-eol="none-announced" data-power="dc">
  <style>
    [data-path] { cursor: pointer; }
    .state-on    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-up    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    /* link and up are the same fact on an Ethernet lamp; see docs/rj45-family-design.md */
    .state-link  { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-activity { --led-color: #86efac; }
    .state-ok    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-fault { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-fail  { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-locate { --led-color: #3b82f6; }
    .state-absent { opacity: 0.35; }
    /* A SWITCHED OUTLET WITH NO LAMP is dimmed when it is off, as absent is but
       less (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 3.2): every switched PDU in the
       library has a lamp per outlet, and this is the fallback so the first one
       without does not invent a lamp. An outlet a lamp is bound to by `for:`
       carries data-lamped (mark_lamped) and is never dimmed: its lamp says it. */
    [data-class='inlet'][data-states~='off'].state-off:not([data-lamped]) { opacity: 0.55; }
    /* A state is a colour AND a behaviour. Solid and blinking of the same colour
       are different facts on real hardware: on the S9510-28DC a solid green PWR
       is "system power good" and a blinking green PWR is "power good but BMC
       power fail". A blinking state that renders solid is the same failure as a
       state class nothing paints - it looks modelled and is not.
       blink animates opacity rather than fill, because each skin carries its own
       unlit colour in the fill fallback and a keyframe cannot name it. alternate
       animates fill, because two colours is the whole point, and takes its first
       value from the element's own fill. */
    @keyframes portrayal-blink {
      0%, 49.9% { opacity: 1; }
      50%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes portrayal-alternate {
      0%, 49.9% { fill: var(--led-color, #3a3f44); }
      50%, 100% { fill: var(--led-color-alt, #3a3f44); }
    }
    .portrayal-highlight { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.2px #f59e0b) drop-shadow(0 0 0.5px #f59e0b); }
    .portrayal-dim { opacity: 0.25; }
    [data-class='region'].portrayal-highlight { stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 0.7; filter: none; }

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="592.0mm" height="43.7mm" viewBox="0 0 592.0 43.7" data-device="7280cr3a-24d12" data-view="left" data-weight="14.8 kg (32.6 lbs) for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12 (guide Table 1); 32.6 lbs (14.79 kg) in the data sheet" data-size-over-ears="48.3 x 4.4 x 59.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 23.3 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)" data-throughput="7.2 (14.4) Tbps" data-packets-per-second="2.7 Bpps" data-latency="from 3.8 us" data-packet-buffer="8 GB" data-max-400g-ports="12" data-max-100g-ports="72" data-max-50g-ports="116" data-max-40g-ports="36" data-max-25-10g-ports="116" data-max-total-interfaces="116" data-power-draw-typical-w="346" data-power-draw-max-w="845" data-power-draw-note="Data sheet: "346 W / 845 W", typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers. Guide Table 4 reads TBD." data-psu-redundancy="1+1" data-input-ac="200 - 240 VAC, 9.6 A (PWR-1511-AC), IEC 60320 C14" data-input-dc="-48 to -60 VDC (PWR-1511-DC)" data-airflow="front-to-back" data-fan-redundancy="3 hot-swap fan modules, N+1" data-operating-temp="0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F)" data-storage-temp="-25 to 70 C (-13 to 158 F)" data-storage-temp-datasheet="-40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet" data-altitude="0 to 3,000 m (0 to 10,000 ft)" data-humidity="5 to 90 percent, non-condensing" data-cpu="Eight-core x86" data-system-memory="64 GB" data-ssd-storage="480 GB" data-software="EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet" data-feature-license="EOS Feature Licenses Group 4" data-optics-qsfp28="each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-optics-qsfp-dd="each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-precision-timing="PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs" data-encryption="none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12" data-console="RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control" data-oob="10/100/1000 Ethernet management port" data-safety="EN 62368-1:2020+A11:2020, IEC 62368-1:2018, CSA/UL 62368-1:2019, AS/NZS 62368.1:2022" data-emissions="FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015" data-regulatory-model-number="AN1779 (DCS-7280CR3A-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AM-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12), guide Table 14" data-eol="none-announced" data-power="ac">
  <style>
    [data-path] { cursor: pointer; }
    .state-on    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-up    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    /* link and up are the same fact on an Ethernet lamp; see docs/rj45-family-design.md */
    .state-link  { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-activity { --led-color: #86efac; }
    .state-ok    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-fault { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-fail  { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-locate { --led-color: #3b82f6; }
    .state-absent { opacity: 0.35; }
    /* A SWITCHED OUTLET WITH NO LAMP is dimmed when it is off, as absent is but
       less (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 3.2): every switched PDU in the
       library has a lamp per outlet, and this is the fallback so the first one
       without does not invent a lamp. An outlet a lamp is bound to by `for:`
       carries data-lamped (mark_lamped) and is never dimmed: its lamp says it. */
    [data-class='inlet'][data-states~='off'].state-off:not([data-lamped]) { opacity: 0.55; }
    /* A state is a colour AND a behaviour. Solid and blinking of the same colour
       are different facts on real hardware: on the S9510-28DC a solid green PWR
       is "system power good" and a blinking green PWR is "power good but BMC
       power fail". A blinking state that renders solid is the same failure as a
       state class nothing paints - it looks modelled and is not.
       blink animates opacity rather than fill, because each skin carries its own
       unlit colour in the fill fallback and a keyframe cannot name it. alternate
       animates fill, because two colours is the whole point, and takes its first
       value from the element's own fill. */
    @keyframes portrayal-blink {
      0%, 49.9% { opacity: 1; }
      50%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes portrayal-alternate {
      0%, 49.9% { fill: var(--led-color, #3a3f44); }
      50%, 100% { fill: var(--led-color-alt, #3a3f44); }
    }
    .portrayal-highlight { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.2px #f59e0b) drop-shadow(0 0 0.5px #f59e0b); }
    .portrayal-dim { opacity: 0.25; }
    [data-class='region'].portrayal-highlight { stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 0.7; filter: none; }

       are different facts on real hardware: on the S9510-28DC a solid green PWR
       is "system power good" and a blinking green PWR is "power good but BMC
       power fail". A blinking state that renders solid is the same failure as a
       state class nothing paints - it looks modelled and is not.
       blink animates opacity rather than fill, because each skin carries its own
       unlit colour in the fill fallback and a keyframe cannot name it. alternate
       animates fill, because two colours is the whole point, and takes its first
       value from the element's own fill. */
    @keyframes portrayal-blink {

    [data-class='region'].portrayal-highlight { stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 0.7; filter: none; }

Guide Table 4 reads TBD." data-psu-redundancy="1+1" data-input-ac="200 - 240 VAC, 9.6 A (PWR-1511-AC), IEC 60320 C14" data-input-dc="-48 to -60 VDC (PWR-1511-DC)" data-airflow="back-to-front" data-fan-redundancy="3 hot-swap fan modules, N+1" data-operating-temp="0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F)" data-storage-temp="-25 to 70 C (-13 to 158 F)" data-storage-temp-datasheet="-40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet" data-altitude="0 to 3,000 m (0 to 10,000 ft)" data-humidity="5 to 90 percent, non-condensing" data-cpu="Eight-core x86" data-system-memory="64 GB" data-ssd-storage="480 GB" data-software="EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet" data-feature-license="EOS Feature Licenses Group 4" data-optics-qsfp28="each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-optics-qsfp-dd="each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-precision-timing="PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs" data-encryption="none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12" data-console="RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control" data-oob="10/100/1000 Ethernet management port" data-safety="EN 62368-1:2020+A11:2020, IEC 62368-1:2018, CSA/UL 62368-1:2019, AS/NZS 62368.1:2022" data-emissions="FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015" data-regulatory-model-number="AN1779 (DCS-7280CR3A-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AM-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12), guide Table 14" data-eol="none-announced" data-power="ac">
  <style>
    [data-path] { cursor: pointer; }
    .state-on    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-up    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    /* link and up are the same fact on an Ethernet lamp; see docs/rj45-family-design.md */
    .state-link  { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-activity { --led-color: #86efac; }
    .state-ok    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-fault { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-fail  { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-locate { --led-color: #3b82f6; }
    .state-absent { opacity: 0.35; }
    /* A SWITCHED OUTLET WITH NO LAMP is dimmed when it is off, as absent is but
       less (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 3.2): every switched PDU in the
       library has a lamp per outlet, and this is the fallback so the first one
       without does not invent a lamp. An outlet a lamp is bound to by `for:`
       carries data-lamped (mark_lamped) and is never dimmed: its lamp says it. */
    [data-class='inlet'][data-states~='off'].state-off:not([data-lamped]) { opacity: 0.55; }

       state class nothing paints - it looks modelled and is not.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="592.0mm" height="43.7mm" viewBox="0 0 592.0 43.7" data-device="7280cr3a-24d12" data-view="left" data-weight="14.8 kg (32.6 lbs) for the 7280CR3A-24D12, 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12 (guide Table 1); 32.6 lbs (14.79 kg) in the data sheet" data-size-over-ears="48.3 x 4.4 x 59.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 23.3 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)" data-throughput="7.2 (14.4) Tbps" data-packets-per-second="2.7 Bpps" data-latency="from 3.8 us" data-packet-buffer="8 GB" data-max-400g-ports="12" data-max-100g-ports="72" data-max-50g-ports="116" data-max-40g-ports="36" data-max-25-10g-ports="116" data-max-total-interfaces="116" data-power-draw-typical-w="346" data-power-draw-max-w="845" data-power-draw-note="Data sheet: "346 W / 845 W", typical measured at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers. Guide Table 4 reads TBD." data-psu-redundancy="1+1" data-input-ac="200 - 240 VAC, 9.6 A (PWR-1511-AC), IEC 60320 C14" data-input-dc="-48 to -60 VDC (PWR-1511-DC)" data-airflow="back-to-front" data-fan-redundancy="3 hot-swap fan modules, N+1" data-operating-temp="0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F)" data-storage-temp="-25 to 70 C (-13 to 158 F)" data-storage-temp-datasheet="-40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet" data-altitude="0 to 3,000 m (0 to 10,000 ft)" data-humidity="5 to 90 percent, non-condensing" data-cpu="Eight-core x86" data-system-memory="64 GB" data-ssd-storage="480 GB" data-software="EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet" data-feature-license="EOS Feature Licenses Group 4" data-optics-qsfp28="each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-optics-qsfp-dd="each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-precision-timing="PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs" data-encryption="none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12" data-console="RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control" data-oob="10/100/1000 Ethernet management port" data-safety="EN 62368-1:2020+A11:2020, IEC 62368-1:2018, CSA/UL 62368-1:2019, AS/NZS 62368.1:2022" data-emissions="FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015" data-regulatory-model-number="AN1779 (DCS-7280CR3A-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AM-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12), guide Table 14" data-eol="none-announced" data-power="ac">
  <style>
    [data-path] { cursor: pointer; }
    .state-on    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-up    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    /* link and up are the same fact on an Ethernet lamp; see docs/rj45-family-design.md */
    .state-link  { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-activity { --led-color: #86efac; }
    .state-ok    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-fault { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-fail  { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-locate { --led-color: #3b82f6; }
    .state-absent { opacity: 0.35; }
    /* A SWITCHED OUTLET WITH NO LAMP is dimmed when it is off, as absent is but
       less (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 3.2): every switched PDU in the
       library has a lamp per outlet, and this is the fallback so the first one
       without does not invent a lamp. An outlet a lamp is bound to by `for:`
       carries data-lamped (mark_lamped) and is never dimmed: its lamp says it. */
    [data-class='inlet'][data-states~='off'].state-off:not([data-lamped]) { opacity: 0.55; }
    /* A state is a colour AND a behaviour. Solid and blinking of the same colour
       are different facts on real hardware: on the S9510-28DC a solid green PWR
       is "system power good" and a blinking green PWR is "power good but BMC
       power fail". A blinking state that renders solid is the same failure as a
       state class nothing paints - it looks modelled and is not.
       blink animates opacity rather than fill, because each skin carries its own
       unlit colour in the fill fallback and a keyframe cannot name it. alternate
       animates fill, because two colours is the whole point, and takes its first
       value from the element's own fill. */
    @keyframes portrayal-blink {
      0%, 49.9% { opacity: 1; }
      50%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes portrayal-alternate {
      0%, 49.9% { fill: var(--led-color, #3a3f44); }
      50%, 100% { fill: var(--led-color-alt, #3a3f44); }
    }
    .portrayal-highlight { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.2px #f59e0b) drop-shadow(0 0 0.5px #f59e0b); }
    .portrayal-dim { opacity: 0.25; }
    [data-class='region'].portrayal-highlight { stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 0.7; filter: none; }

       are different facts on real hardware: on the S9510-28DC a solid green PWR
       is "system power good" and a blinking green PWR is "power good but BMC
       power fail". A blinking state that renders solid is the same failure as a
       state class nothing paints - it looks modelled and is not.
       blink animates opacity rather than fill, because each skin carries its own
       unlit colour in the fill fallback and a keyframe cannot name it. alternate
       animates fill, because two colours is the whole point, and takes its first
       value from the element's own fill. */
    @keyframes portrayal-blink {

      50%, 100% { opacity: 0; }

    [data-class='region'].portrayal-highlight { stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 0.7; filter: none; }

Guide Table 4 reads TBD." data-psu-redundancy="1+1" data-input-ac="200 - 240 VAC, 9.6 A (PWR-1511-AC), IEC 60320 C14" data-input-dc="-48 to -60 VDC (PWR-1511-DC)" data-airflow="back-to-front" data-fan-redundancy="3 hot-swap fan modules, N+1" data-operating-temp="0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F)" data-storage-temp="-25 to 70 C (-13 to 158 F)" data-storage-temp-datasheet="-40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet" data-altitude="0 to 3,000 m (0 to 10,000 ft)" data-humidity="5 to 90 percent, non-condensing" data-cpu="Eight-core x86" data-system-memory="64 GB" data-ssd-storage="480 GB" data-software="EOS; minimum release 4.31.1 per the data sheet" data-feature-license="EOS Feature Licenses Group 4" data-optics-qsfp28="each of the 24 QSFP cages runs 100G, or 40G (QSFP+), 50G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-optics-qsfp-dd="each of the 12 QSFP-DD cages runs 400G, or 100G, 50G, 40G and 25/10G modes by breakout (data sheet)" data-precision-timing="PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs" data-encryption="none on the 7280CR3A-24D12; all ports (MACsec, IPsec and VXLANsec) on the 7280CR3AM-24D12 and 7280CR3AK-24D12" data-console="RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control" data-oob="10/100/1000 Ethernet management port" data-safety="EN 62368-1:2020+A11:2020, IEC 62368-1:2018, CSA/UL 62368-1:2019, AS/NZS 62368.1:2022" data-emissions="FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015" data-regulatory-model-number="AN1779 (DCS-7280CR3A-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AM-24D12, DCS-7280CR3AK-24D12), guide Table 14" data-eol="none-announced" data-power="ac">
  <style>
    [data-path] { cursor: pointer; }
    .state-on    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-up    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    /* link and up are the same fact on an Ethernet lamp; see docs/rj45-family-design.md */
    .state-link  { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-activity { --led-color: #86efac; }
    .state-ok    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-fault { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-fail  { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-locate { --led-color: #3b82f6; }
    .state-absent { opacity: 0.35; }
    /* A SWITCHED OUTLET WITH NO LAMP is dimmed when it is off, as absent is but
       less (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 3.2): every switched PDU in the
       library has a lamp per outlet, and this is the fallback so the first one
       without does not invent a lamp. An outlet a lamp is bound to by `for:`
       carries data-lamped (mark_lamped) and is never dimmed: its lamp says it. */
    [data-class='inlet'][data-states~='off'].state-off:not([data-lamped]) { opacity: 0.55; }
